entry.content:
We help Nigerian small businesses automate operations, reduce manual work, and scale with AI.

What We Do

Workflow Automation

Email sorting, invoicing, reporting, follow-ups — automated so you can focus on running your business.

AI Agent Systems

Customer support, data gathering, scheduling — agents that work 24/7.

Financial Automation

Revenue tracking, expense management, reconciliation — no more spreadsheet headaches.

Document Automation

Invoices, proposals, reports — generated from templates automatically.

Who We Help

  • Transportation operators — daily remittance tracking, maintenance scheduling
  • Schools — student records, fee management, result processing
  • Retail businesses — inventory, invoicing, customer follow-ups
  • Any business drowning in paperwork

Our Process

  1. Discovery — We ask questions, understand your operations
  2. Proposal — Clear scope, timeline, and pricing in Naira
  3. Build — Develop and test the automation
  4. Deploy — Launch, monitor, iterate
  5. Support — Ongoing maintenance and improvements

Pricing

We work on a rolling budget model — start small, scale as you see value.

Typical starting budget: N20,000 - N50,000 for the first automation.

Case Studies

Coming soon — we're building our first projects now.

Get Started

Email us at netzro@gmail.com with a brief description of your business and what you'd like to automate. We'll respond within 24 hours.
